reproduction_target: Computational metagenomic genome-phenome association (metaGPA) analysis of REase-enriched dZ phage metagenomes: read trimming (Trim Galore v0.6.4), metaSPAdes assembly, bowtie2 back-mapping, metaGPA main pipeline with contig enrichment score -C 10, Pfam (release 33.0) domain annotation and domain-association analysis, composite-dataset construction across four samples, plus downstream alignment/phylogeny (mafft v7.508, RAxML v8.2.12), residue differential conservation (Two Sample Logo), structural multi-alignment (PROMALS3D) and tree visualization (iTOL). Wet-lab enrichment, cloning, protein purification, in vivo dZ incorporation and UHPLC-MS steps are out of computational-reproduction scope.
granularity_note: Coarse one-step-per-named-tool from the bioRxiv v1 full-text Methods ('Materials and Methods' -> 'Data process and metaGPA analysis', 'Creation of the composite data set', 'Alignment and phylogenetic analysis') plus tool mentions embedded in Results/figure legends (metaSPAdes, bowtie2, Two Sample Logo, PROMALS3D). JATS source XML returned HTTP 403; the v1 .full HTML was retrieved instead and carries the complete Methods text. The paper has a 'Data accessibility' section (SRA PRJNA1346114) but NO code availability section: the only code statement is 'MetaGPA code and analysis is available as described in (Yang et al. 2021)' - an indirect pointer to a prior publication, with no repository URL, commit, release or version given in this paper. No repository landing page or README was therefore read (none is cited here).

steps.label: Trim Galore v0.6.4 trimming of paired-end FASTQ reads (--paired)
metaSPAdes assembly of reads into contigs (control + treated libraries) - no version, no parameters stated
Assembly merge + redundancy removal and bowtie2 back-mapping of control/treated read pairs to the combined assembly - no version, no parameters stated

metaGPA main pipeline run per sample (default parameters except contig enrichment score -C 10); code referenced only as 'available as described in (Yang et al. 2021)' with no URL/commit/version in this paper
Pfam domain annotation of contigs using Pfam database release 33.0 (annotating software and its version not named in prose)
Composite dataset construction: concatenation of modified contigs (enrichment score >= 10) and unmodified contigs (< 10) across the four samples - no script or code artifact provided
Re-execution of the Pfam domain association analysis (metaGPA pipeline) on the composite dataset - no version, association thresholds not restated
Residue differential conservation analysis and domain co-occurrence analysis 'as described in the original metaGPA study' - method deferred to prior paper, no version, no parameters
mafft v7.508 multiple sequence alignment of full coding sequences of annotated protein domains (parameters not stated)
RAxML v8.2.12 maximum-likelihood phylogenies (-f a rapid bootstrap, -m PROTGAMMAAUTO, -p 1237, -x 1234)
Two Sample Logo sequence-logo generation for top differentially conserved residues (default parameters, residues shown if p < 0.05) - no version, hosted tool
PROMALS3D structural multiple alignment + secondary structure prediction for VpDpoZ vs de novo DpoZ homologs - hosted web service, no version, no parameters
iTOL (https://itol.embl.de/) tree visualization - hosted web service, no version, no settings recorded

headline.static_readiness: 0/13 (0%) - stage1 ceiling only, no R-star (R-star needs stage-2 code verification)
headline.inference_inclusive_upper_bound: RI ceiling on 3/13 computational steps (Trim Galore v0.6.4, mafft v7.508, RAxML v8.2.12 - the only tools with exact prose version pins). 10/13 steps cap at NI: metaSPAdes, bowtie2, the metaGPA pipeline itself, the Pfam annotation step, composite-dataset construction, the composite association re-run, residue conservation / co-occurrence analysis, Two Sample Logo, PROMALS3D and iTOL all lack version pins, and the two web services (PROMALS3D, iTOL) additionally have no obtainable code. R-star is not assignable at stage1; and since no lockfile, container or environment specification is claimed anywhere in the paper, no step could exceed RI even at stage2 without an executed environment capture.
headline.coverage: 13 computational steps assessed from bioRxiv v1 full-text Methods prose plus tool mentions in Results/figure legends. 10 wet-lab steps counted (W: sample collection + phenol-chloroform gDNA extraction, REase cocktail enrichment, AMPure size selection, Covaris shearing + NEBNext library prep + Illumina NextSeq sequencing, qPCR enrichment-efficiency assay, plasmid cloning/construct assembly, Ni-NTA protein purification, in vivo dZ incorporation in E. coli, NDT enzymatic assay, UHPLC-MS nucleoside quantification) but out of computational-reproduction scope.

gaps.where: Code availability (absent section); Methods 'Data process and metaGPA analysis'
gaps.missing: The paper contains no code availability statement. The only code pointer is 'MetaGPA code and analysis is available as described in (Yang et al. 2021)' - an indirect citation to a prior publication with no repository URL, no commit, no release tag and no version recorded in this paper. The custom composite-dataset construction (concatenation by enrichment score, re-run of the association analysis) is described in prose only, with no script deposited.
gaps.how_to_close: Add a Code availability section giving the exact repository URL plus commit hash or release tag of the metaGPA version actually run, and deposit the analysis/driver scripts used for the composite dataset, the association re-run, the residue differential conservation and the co-occurrence analyses.

gaps.missing: No environment lockfile, no container image or digest, no conda/pixi environment specification is claimed anywhere. Version capture is partial and static: only Trim Galore v0.6.4, mafft v7.508 and RAxML v8.2.12 carry exact pins (plus Pfam DB release 33.0 as a data-resource pin); nothing pins interpreter, system libraries or transitive dependencies.
gaps.how_to_close: Publish a lockfile (conda-lock / pixi) or a container digest covering every tool and its dependencies for the platform on which the analysis was run.

gaps.where: metaSPAdes, bowtie2, metaGPA pipeline, Pfam annotation software, Two Sample Logo, PROMALS3D, iTOL
gaps.missing: No version numbers are given for these tools; the metaGPA pipeline itself (the central analysis) has neither a version nor a commit. These steps therefore cannot reach RI.
gaps.how_to_close: Record the exact version (and build) of every tool invoked, including the metaGPA pipeline commit and the software used for Pfam annotation (e.g. HMMER release).

gaps.where: C11 Two Sample Logo, C12 PROMALS3D, C13 iTOL
gaps.missing: Three analysis/visualization steps rely on hosted web services with no version, no access date and no exported settings. Server-side updates make these outputs non-deterministic and the code is not obtainable.
gaps.how_to_close: Record the service version and access date, export and deposit the exact input/output files, or substitute scriptable local equivalents with pinned versions.

gaps.where: Intermediate analysis inputs (contigs, ORF sets, domain alignments used for C8-C13)
gaps.missing: The Data accessibility statement covers 'all raw and processed sequencing data' under SRA PRJNA1346114, but the specific intermediate artifacts fed to the alignment, phylogeny, logo and structural-alignment steps (per-domain coding sequence FASTA, alignments, tree files, reference sequences pulled from external databases) are not individually deposited or enumerated.
gaps.how_to_close: Deposit the intermediate FASTA/alignment/tree files (e.g. as a figshare/Zenodo archive) with a manifest linking each figure to its input files.

gaps.where: Wet-lab: aquatic phage sampling and PEG precipitation, phenol-chloroform gDNA extraction, seven-REase enrichment cocktail, AMPure size selection, Covaris shearing + NEBNext Ultra II library prep + Illumina NextSeq 75 bp PE sequencing, qPCR enrichment assay, plasmid construction (pET21b/pACYCT7/pET28a/pET28b), Ni-NTA protein purification, in vivo dZ incorporation in T7 Express E. coli, NDT enzymatic assay, Agilent 1290 UHPLC-MS nucleoside quantification
gaps.missing: Physical sample-generation and biochemical validation steps are out of scope for computational reproduction (OOS); counted in W (10), not verdicted. Raw reads are deposited under SRA PRJNA1346114, which is the reproducible entry point into the computational pipeline.
